from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now()
now_year, now_month = now.year, now.month
print('now', now_year, now_month)

# Get supervisor cards and pick one that is not expired as of now
cards = apis.supervisor.show_payment_cards()
print('supervisor_cards', cards)

def is_valid(card):
    y=card['expiry_year']
    m=card['expiry_month']
    return (y>now_year) or (y==now_year and m>=now_month)

valid_cards=[c for c in cards if is_valid(c)]
print('valid_cards_count', len(valid_cards))
print('valid_cards', valid_cards)

card_to_use = valid_cards[0]
print('card_to_use', card_to_use)

# Add to Venmo payment cards
venmo_access_token=globals()['venmo_access_token']
add_res = apis.venmo.add_payment_card(
    card_name=card_to_use['card_name'],
    owner_name=card_to_use['owner_name'],
    card_number=card_to_use['card_number'],
    expiry_year=card_to_use['expiry_year'],
    expiry_month=card_to_use['expiry_month'],
    cvv_number=card_to_use['cvv_number'],
    access_token=venmo_access_token
)

payment_card_id = add_res['payment_card_id']

# Send $58 to Katherine
